summary: 72 mm diameter disc wheel, 6 mm overall width at the rim. The center web is 3 mm thick and recessed on both faces. It has a 14 mm center bore and a mounting pattern of round holes and short slots.

mountingSurfaces.description: Recessed web face on the +z side, 3 mm web thickness, carrying the bore and hole pattern. The rim stands proud to z = +3.
Recessed web face on the -z side, mirrored. The rim stands proud to z = -3.

notes: The 72 mm diameter, 6 mm width, 3 mm web, 14 mm bore, 32 mm and 16 mm pattern spacings and 4 mm hole size are printed on the drawing. The 62 mm dimension is the recessed face diameter; its drawn extent suggests the recess is shallow, roughly 1.5 mm per side. The recess depth and web centering are read from the section view, not stated. The 4 mm holes at (±16, ±16) are round. The holes at (±8, ±8) look slightly elongated diagonally and are approximated as 4 mm round holes. The four slots on the axes are 4 mm wide, listed as end-arc centers at 11 mm and 16 mm from center (slot positions are my estimate from the drawing scale). The listed hole positions are approximate (about ±0.5 mm) and should be checked against the vendor CAD before use.
